in_latin.name: Ralfus
in_latin.meaning: Ralfus, a diminutive form of Ralph, meaning ruler of the people, noble, and exalted
in_latin.long_meaning: Ralfus, forma diminutiva Ralf, significat dominus populi, nobilis, et exaltatus. Origine a Ralf, nomine Germanico, significante dominus populi. In medio aevo, Ralfus erat nomen nobilium, qui dominabantur in regno Anglorum. Hic nomen, cum sua longa historia, continet virtutes nobilitatis, sapientiam, et potentiam.
